services.name: Enso Karate
services.desc: Adults who are interested in getting started in karate are welcome to join any of the Beginners classes indicated in our class schedule. Some are designated as “Youth and Adult” which will have a mix of ages, and are great for families who would like to train together. The “Adult” beginner classes are only for adults, which may be preferred by some. We welcome adults of all fitness levels. Give it a try! See trial class opportunities. Returning Students Enso welcomes students who are interested in continuing their training in Shotokan or transitioning from a different martial arts style. services.desc: Kids ages 5-12 love our popular, fun-filled camp typically held in August. The camp is open to current karate students as well as kids new to martial arts! Led by Sensei Jay and his amazing team of instructors, kids enjoy a week of lively activities, including: Our karate camp is designed to keep campers moving in a positive, social setting. Every year, we return with new ideas, activities, and entertainment! The highlight is the “Camp Show” and Pizza Party to showcase their camp experience while the camper’s family and friends are invited to watch!
